behavior: `Menu.Positioner`, `Popover.Positioner`, `Select.Positioner` and `Combobox.Positioner` have one root node, also while their popup is modal: `Menu.Portal`, `Popover.Portal`, `Select.Portal` and `Combobox.Portal` render the internal backdrop of a modal popup. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show` and a custom directive of the consumer thus apply to the element of the positioner. `Autocomplete.Portal` and `Autocomplete.Positioner` are the parts of Combobox under other names. In Base UI, the positioner renders the backdrop beside its element.
